name: dryrun_02_phoenix_smoke_test
notes: Pre-registration Q1 v0.4, Section 6 'Dry run and smoke test (about 10 minutes; first; sets locked time per point)' and 'the ibm_phoenix smoke test uses about 5 Flex minutes'; Gate 2 (Section 5) is checked on its output; tracker P1.2.2. Paper 1 smoke test: the 4x5 patch (n = 20, origin (8,1), qubits 81-85, 91-95, 101-105, 111-115, edge 93_103 under the 2026-09-19T155931Z snapshot) at L = 2 and L = 8, k = 1, M = 10 draws, 4096 shots, resilience 0 / 1 / 2 (three Estimator jobs: locked time per point, depth ceiling, mitigation overhead). Probes (Section 3b, Deviation 16 reset dial, kill rules (b)-(d)): a reset-arm shifted pair at n = 20, L = 8, k = L, p = 0.25 with 4 masks x 64 shots at resilience 1 (the level used on the Paper 1 grid), its delay(400 ns)-matched control with the same masks, and the reset-error characterisation mini-sequence on the 20 patch qubits (prepare |1> -> native reset -> measure Z, 1024 shots, resilience 0; P(1) = (1 - <Z>)/2, kill rule (a) threshold 2e-2). The runner records backend.default_rep_delay and rep_delay_range (rep_delay_probe) and the ISA instruction names, measure count and reset/delay durations per circuit. Budget by the Section 3b formula 2 s + (rep_delay + circuit length) x executions at the default 250 us rep_delay, target at most 5 Flex minutes; the ZNE bound counts the resilience-2 circuits three times. Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is TBD.

probes.purpose: reset-arm probe: Estimator accepts a mid-circuit reset at resilience 1 (kill rule d); ISA name and duration (kill rule c)
delay(400 ns)-matched control of the reset-arm probe (same masks, same theta)
reset-error characterisation mini-sequence on the 20 patch qubits: |1> -> reset -> measure (kill rule a)

budget.formula: 2 s per job + (rep_delay + L x 0.71 us + 1.94 us readout [+ dial durations]) x executions
